trans-unit.source: Pay with your Bitcoin wallet, in Lightning or on-chain. Once you have placed your order, you get a QR code to scan with your wallet.

trans-unit.source: Scan the QR code with your Bitcoin wallet, or open the invoice in your wallet.

trans-unit.source: The Bitcoin network is confirming its on-chain transaction, which takes about 30 minutes. You can close this page: you will get an e-mail once your order is paid.

trans-unit.target: Il tuo ordine è ancora in elaborazione. Attendi un momento, poi effettualo di nuovo.

trans-unit.target: Il tuo pagamento è arrivato in tempo.
